'''Michael Schiermeyer''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2001 Colorado Springs tournament (19 August)]] on 19 August 2001 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|HDADTJ Podracing (rated 1465)]], according to Patrick Napier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2875">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-20-colorado-springs-a-howwible-day-8-19-01d2875/ colorado-springs-a-howwible-day-8-19-01], DeckTech (Patrick "Pappy" Napier, 20 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-20-colorado-springs-a-howwible-day-8-19-01d2875/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
